title: hive answer-digest output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive answer-digest --json`. The success envelope reports whether a Telegram digest of human-blocking tasks was sent (sent/reason/dry_run/chat_id), the attached button count, and the full waiting set (count/tasks) so an agent can learn how many and which tasks wait even on a real send where message is null. Usage errors emit the ErrorPayload: a bad --date (Hive::ConfigError, error_kind=config) and a status outage (StatusUnavailableError, error_kind=status_unavailable) via the in-command envelope, and bad flags (Thor::Error, error_kind=usage) via JSON_USAGE_ERROR_CONTRACTS. A Telegram send error mid-delivery surfaces on stderr + a non-zero exit code without an envelope.

date.description: The local calendar date echoed from --date (or today's local date). Does not scope the (always-live) waiting set or dedup sends; scheduler idempotency lives in answer_digest_state.json.

sent.description: true only when a Telegram message was actually sent (reason is null). Derived from reason.

reason.description: null = a digest was sent; empty = nothing was waiting, so nothing was sent; dry_run = the digest was rendered but not sent (--dry-run).

dry_run.description: true when invoked with --dry-run; nothing was sent to Telegram.

chat_id.description: The Telegram chat the digest was sent to (the first bot.chat_id_allowlist entry). null when nothing was sent (empty/dry_run).

button_count.description: The number of inline buttons attached to the sent message, capped at the 10-task display cap. Use `count` for the true total.

count.description: The true number of tasks waiting on human input (uncapped).

tasks.description: One entry per waiting task, in delivery order. Present even on a real send (where message is null).

message.description: The rendered digest text on a --dry-run (so a caller can preview it); null on a real send and on an empty waiting set.

id.description: The numeric task id, when assigned.

title.description: The display title (`#<id> <name>`, name, or slug-derived fallback).

stage.description: The current stage directory the task waits in.

pr.description: The `#<number>` pull-request label when a PR exists, else null.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the error class that was raised.

error_kind.description: usage = malformed invocation caught before command dispatch (exit 64). config = bad --date / missing chat config (exit 78). status_unavailable = `hive status --json` came back unusable (exit 1, retryable). internal = uncategorised crash (exit 1/70).
